{{Top|leg}}
'''Kadri'Ra''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Kadri'Ra]] race.

It was dismissed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] historians as the "indigent dialect of an intellectually inferior [[Species/Legends|species]]".

The Kadri'Ra [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] spoke only in his native tongue by choice and his personal attendant, the former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Guzald]], was one of the few individuals who could understand the language.
